title: LAMF Export Bundle Manifest
description: manifest.json inside an encrypted .lamf export bundle (DECISIONS.md §M.2, U-13). Container format: tar (ustar) payload encrypted with chunked XChaCha20-Poly1305 (1 MiB chunks, counter nonce). Manifest + checksums are MACed with an HKDF-derived export key inside the encrypted container. Extraction caps on import: at most 10,000 entries and 4 GiB uncompressed (no compression, so no ratio guard); path allowlist `^[a-z0-9_./-]+$` PLUS a Windows device-name denylist (con, nul, aux, prn, com1-9, lpt1-9 — any case, any extension) enforced OUTSIDE the regex, and empty segments, '.', 'a//b', 'a/./b', and trailing '/' are rejected. Import verifies MAC/checksums, checkpoint signature and chain against the pinned instance pubkey (operator confirms the fingerprint out-of-band), applies the only-tightens policy rule, and always rebuilds indexes and vector caches from the spine.

lamf_version.description: semver of the exporting LAMF instance (package version, e.g. 2.0.0)

created_at.description: unix ms when the bundle was built

seq_range.description: inclusive spine seq range contained in the bundle

chain_head_hash.description: displayed at export; operator types it at import (DECISIONS.md §H out-of-band confirm)

instance_sig.description: instance Ed25519 signature over the checkpoint, base64url

instance_pubkey.description: instance Ed25519 public key (base64url) that signed this checkpoint, pinned in the manifest (U-13d); import anchors checkpoint verification on it (T-instance-key-anchored)

fingerprint.description: display fingerprint of instance_pubkey; the operator confirms it out-of-band at import (TOFU, U-13d)

checkpoint.description: latest sealed checkpoint (DECISIONS.md §H) — the chain head

path.description: safe relative path only: lowercase charset [a-z0-9_./-], no leading '/', no '..' anywhere, no backslash, no symlinks (DECISIONS.md §M.3 / floor F4). Extraction (U-13c) additionally rejects — outside this regex — empty segments, '.', 'a//b', 'a/./b', trailing '/', and the Windows device-name denylist (con, nul, aux, prn, com1-9, lpt1-9, any case, any extension)

policy_profile.description: active profile at export; import applies the only-tightens rule against the local profile/floor

excludes.description: content classes deliberately absent from the bundle: quarantine (excluded unless approved first, §J/§M.8), vector caches and indexes (always rebuilt from spine, §M.3/§M.8), secret values (never exported, §M.7), receipts (operator-read-only, U-08f), spool segments, and all instance key material (the instance key is NEVER exported, U-13a)

mac.description: lowercase hex HMAC-SHA-256 over the manifest and checksums (DECISIONS.md U-13b): mac = HMAC-SHA-256(key = HKDF-SHA-256(export_key, info="lamf-manifest-mac"), msg = canon(manifest_without_mac) || canon(checksums)); verified after container decrypt, before any extraction
